regime_context: The detector shows broad leadership concentration in Canadian resource extraction: Oil & Gas Producers is the clear, crowded leader (score 1.612, durability 0.68, breadth 0.786) with Gold Miners a distant challenger (1.11). There is no dominant single narrative (not one-narrative). The only validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control; momentum rank is a focus lens only, so this note defaults to few, low-conviction, falsifiable leans.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Oil & Gas Producers' crowded=true condition combines with breadth remaining above ~0.75 while its momentum rank stays #1 through the next month — a handoff to Gold Miners as leader would only be confirmed if Gold Miners overtakes Oil & Gas in score AND Oil & Gas breadth drops below 0.5. I am not calling the rotation; I am watching for that specific handoff signature.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The trend-gate leg is the only validated leg, and Oil & Gas is eligible with the highest durability_bar (0.68) and strongest breadth (0.786) of any eligible theme, suggesting the trend itself is broad-based and intact. Crowding (crowding_z 1.04, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade or sell. I lean with the prevailing trend, not against it.
theses.dissent: The crowding flag and mixed Hurst tag mean the trend may be late-stage; a reflexive unwind in one crowded energy theme can be sharp, and the detector's own backtest verdict says no return-forecast edge exists from the rank.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the only eligible challenger close to the leader (score 1.11, margin 0.502) and is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.2), so it avoids the size-down caution that applies to Oil & Gas. Its durability_bar (0.48) is mid-range and breadth (0.267) is narrow, so this is a trend-following lean on the second-strongest eligible theme rather than a rotation call.
theses.dissent: Breadth is very narrow (0.267), meaning the theme's momentum may be driven by a small subset of names — a fragile leadership structure — and there is no validated edge that the second-ranked theme continues to outperform.
